_comment: Run config for INFERENCE/rescue_abc_batch.sh --songs-json. Same shape as a
generate.py manifest: an optional 'loras' alias registry, a 'defaults' block,
and a 'songs' list. Two deliberate differences from a generation manifest:
* 'songs' entries SELECT pass-1 takes, they do not re-describe a song. A
bare <name> rescues every take of that song; a full <name>_<seed> stem
rescues one take. The rescue reuses each pass-1 take's own lyrics/style/
seed/cap (gate G6), so the ONLY new input per take is its ABC guide,
* a 'songs' entry may override 'lora' and 'cot' per take (a song field wins).
Precedence: per-song field > env (cot/adapter) > 'defaults' > built-in; the
adapter pair is per-song/defaults alias > env 'QF_AR'/'QF_NAR'. For the three
dirs a CLI flag wins over this file. Override one thing to reuse a config:
Omit 'songs' entirely to rescue every track in the pass-1 manifest.

songs.note: arrangement good, pronunciation bad -> rescue this one
per-take override: different adapter + cot for this take only
